newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Denmark sees 1997 inflation at 2.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Denmark sees 1997 inflation at 2.3 pct.

text.p: Denmark's Economy Ministry on Tuesday forecast a 2.3 percent rise in consumer prices in 1997 and 2.4 percent in 1998 using domestic calculation methods, not the EU-harmonised formula.
In its previous report last December, the ministry forecast inflation of 2.3 percent for both this year and 1998.
In 1996, Danish consumer prices rose 2.1 percent using the domestic calculation formula. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
